description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Order to impose annual Levy on Generation, Transmission & Distribution Licenses
reasoning: This gazette notification imposes an annual levy on electricity licensees under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It contains regulatory requirements and compliance measures for licensees, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The content involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories.
